description.value: Kan-Yon Restaurant is a family-owned Chinese and Canadian eatery that has anchored the Hope community since 1974, making it one of the town's longest-running restaurants. Situated at Building C on 3rd Avenue, it offers dine-in, takeout, and online ordering across a broad menu of classic Chinese dishes and Canadian fare made from fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Hope sits at a major junction on cycling routes through the Fraser Canyon and Coquihalla corridor, making this a convenient full-meal stop for touring cyclists passing through.
